//: WHAT THIS SCREEN SAYS IN ITS OWN WORDS, in English. The sentences the domain composes are NOT here: the door hands those over already said, from App/Frases. Every key here must exist in es-CR.json and the other way round: a key that is missing renders as its own name in braces, which is not empty, has spaces and ends where the surrounding sentence ends, so no other check sees it.

comun.elegiCarro: Choose which car the dashboard is for
comun.pendientesAria: {cuantos} details waiting for you to fill in
comun.noEncontrado: There is nothing at this address.

arranque.promesa: This app keeps your fill-ups. Choose where.
arranque.abriendoNavegador: Opening your log saved in this browser…
arranque.permisoCaduco: Your folder is {carpeta}. The browser asks you to confirm write permission every time you reopen the app.
arranque.elegirCarpeta: Choose a folder of your own
arranque.porqueCarpeta: The log stays on your disk, where you put it. It is the only way your assistant can read it.
arranque.porqueElNavegador: It survives closing, but your assistant will not be able to read it: that needs a folder of your own, and this browser does not allow them.
arranque.porqueLaApp: It survives closing, but your assistant will not be able to read it: that needs a folder of your own, and here they are not allowed.
arranque.sinHttps: This page is not on a secure connection, so the browser will not let it save anything — it would be the same in any browser. Come in over https and the saving options appear.
arranque.sinAlmacenamiento: This browser cannot save the log. You can still use the app, but whatever you see is lost when you close it. To have it saved, open it from Chrome or Edge.
arranque.sinAlmacenamientoInstalada: The log cannot be saved here. You can still use the app, but whatever you see is lost when you close it. To have it saved, install it from Chrome or Edge.
arranque.esUnaCarpetaTuya: Is a folder of your own
arranque.notaSinHttps: The folder needs a secure connection (https), so it is not available here.
arranque.notaInstalada: The folder is not available here. To use it, install the app from Chrome or Edge.
arranque.notaNavegador: This browser does not allow choosing a folder. To use it, open the app in Chrome or Edge.
arranque.otraElNavegador: It is saved all the same and survives closing, but the browser manages it: it is not a folder of your own and your assistant cannot read it.
arranque.otraLaApp: It is saved all the same and survives closing, but it stays inside the app: it is not a folder of your own and your assistant cannot read it.
arranque.porqueImportar: Bring one you exported earlier, from this or another computer. It works in any browser.
arranque.porqueSinGuardar: Just to look. Whatever the station published is asked for again when you open, but your odometer readings and confirmations are lost.

aviso.sinGuardar: Nothing is being saved. This app is running with no destination: whatever the station published is asked for again when you open, but your odometer readings and confirmations are lost — nobody but you knows those.
aviso.carpetaRechazo: The folder refused the write. What you see on screen is not saved in {carpeta}. It is usually the permission, which expires on reopening.
aviso.noSePudoPonerAlDia: Could not catch up with the station. Whatever was already recorded is shown all the same.
aviso.migrada: Your new fill-ups now come in through {host}, on this same phone. What you see here stays and is still yours; what this copy stops doing is looking for news.
aviso.sinNovedades: Up to date: the station has nothing new.
aviso.unaNovedad: Up to date: 1 update came in from the station.
aviso.novedades: Up to date: {cuantas} updates came in from the station.

tablero.buscando: Looking for your fill-ups at the station…
tablero.conTanqueLlenoSon: with a full tank that is
tablero.sinAutonomia: A leg closed between two full tanks is needed to know how far it goes, and the range comes from there.
tablero.sinAutonomiaAria: The range cannot be estimated yet
tablero.medidorAria: About {restan} kilometres left of the {lleno} of a full tank
tablero.medidorLlenoAria: With a full tank you get about {lleno} kilometres
tablero.sinTramoCerrado: There is no leg closed between two full tanks yet.
tablero.sinProximaCarga: The range and your daily average are needed.
tablero.sinCosto: An odometer reading is needed to spread the spending.
tablero.sinOdometro: Nobody knows your car's odometer but you. Write it down on one of your fill-ups and this counter starts.
tablero.sinGasto: No fill-up has come in yet.

ruta.loteExplicacion: {cuantas} have the tank estimated from how the pump shut off. If they all ended up as it says, confirm them together; if one did not, go into that fill-up.
ruta.cambiarTanqueAria: Change the tank on the {fecha} fill-up: it ended up {quedo}, becomes {pasaA}
ruta.fotoAria: Your car's dashboard on the {fecha} fill-up
ruta.leeElOdometro: Read the odometer here and write it down below.
ruta.desbloqueoUnTramo: the fuel economy of that leg: {rinde}.
ruta.desbloqueoVariosTramos: the fuel economy of the {cuantos} legs that touch this fill-up: {rinden}.
ruta.sugerencia: around {odometro}? That is what your average of {promedio} per day gives.
ruta.destrabaUnTramo: With this odometer {cuantos} leg gets computed.
ruta.destrabaTramos: With this odometer {cuantos} legs get computed.
ruta.siEsAsi: If that is right, we can work out {desbloqueo}.
ruta.asiFueUnMonto: That is right, I bought a fixed amount
ruta.noSoloUnPoco: No, I only put in a little
ruta.noSeCompara: Not compared against your usual level: {motivo}.
ruta.esperaLosKilometrajesDel: waiting for the odometers from {una} and {otra}

lealtad.carnetApunte: It is drawn on your phone, with no internet. It carries your member number and nothing else: not your history, not the key that opens it.
lealtad.sinCarnet: Your member number has not arrived yet. The station issues it, not the app.
lealtad.sinPuntos: No points have come in from the station yet.
lealtad.sinBoletos: One ticket for every fill-up that reaches the amount. The station issues them.
lealtad.unBoletoPorCada: , one ticket for every {monto} of a fill-up
lealtad.deDondeSalieronApunte: This is what the pump receipt does not say: how many tickets each fill-up gave you, and how much was left over.

miCarro.sinCarros: No fill-up has come in yet, so the app does not know any car.
miCarro.porqueLaPlaca: The station puts the plate on every fill-up: it is not yours to change.
miCarro.porqueElRendimiento: In km/L, what the manual says. It is there to compare what it promises against what your car is actually doing. Leave it empty if you do not know it.
miCarro.otrosCarrosApunte: Choose which one you are looking at with the selector above.
miCarro.laUnidadNoMueveElVeredicto: Changing the unit changes how your fuel economy is said, never the verdict: if your car got worse, it got worse in all three.
miCarro.viveHospedada: In a folder Mymi gave this station, on this same phone, and it is yours. Your assistant can read it from there.
miCarro.viveEnCarpeta: In the folder {carpeta}, and it is saved after every change. It is the only way your assistant can read it.
miCarro.viveEnElNavegador: In this browser. It survives closing, but your assistant cannot read it: that needs a folder of your own.
miCarro.noViveEnNingunLado: Nowhere. The log lives only in memory and is lost when you close.
miCarro.leidaHasta: read up to event {evento} from the station
miCarro.importarReemplaza: Importing replaces your current log with the one in the file you choose. Whatever the station published is asked for again when you open; your odometer readings and confirmations from today only survive if they are in that file. Export first if you want to keep them.
miCarro.listoImportada: Done: the imported log is now open.
miCarro.pasarAGnothi: Hand your notes over to Mymi
miCarro.traspasoPendiente: Notes arrived from your other copy and are waiting for their fill-ups. They settle by themselves as soon as the station publishes them here.
miCarro.queSePasa: Whatever the station published, Mymi asks for again by itself. What you wrote down it does not: {piezas}. This hands it all to Mymi at once, without your credential, and repeating it duplicates nothing.
miCarro.yLasUnidades: and which units you look at it in
miCarro.unaFotoSeQueda: The dashboard photo stays in your folder: it does not travel with this.
miCarro.lasFotosSeQuedan: The {cuantas} dashboard photos stay in your folder: they do not travel with this.
miCarro.sinHojaDeCompartir: This browser has no share sheet, so the file is downloaded: you open it from Mymi afterwards.
miCarro.nadaQuePasar: You have not written down anything to hand over yet: odometer readings, tanks and your car's details show up here once you enter them.
miCarro.listoCompartido: Done: your notes went off to Mymi. If you hand them over again, nothing is duplicated.
miCarro.listoDescargado: Saved: the file with your notes was downloaded. Open it from Mymi when you have it.

fallo.//: EL CANAL DE FALLOS. paso.* es lo que no se pudo hacer y siempre se puede decir; motivo.* es por que, cuando esta app lo sabe. Un motivo que no este aca -- el nombre de un error del browser, la negativa del dominio -- cae al paso, y el texto crudo queda en el detalle tecnico. Las claves son codigos y NO se traducen.
